split_rule: Official anno_test.json is the test set. From anno_train.json only, hold out round(0.15 * n) per style. Styles are visited in order 0, 1, 2. Within a style, records are sorted by image_name and shuffled with random.Random(42).
image_rule: Photo and sketch converted to RGB and stretched to 128x128 with PIL bicubic.
